subject: modelling dispersal and habitat selection simultaneously

messages.author: 29d930b99cef48f0
messages.subject: modelling dispersal and habitat selection simultaneously
parts:
Hi Everyone, 
I'm looking for feedback on how to model the dispersal and habitat selection processes simultaneously, while still treating them independently, via a hierarchical model. I am modelling home range (2nd order selection as per Johnson 1980) selection in an expanding population by modeling the probability that a point is within a pre-defined home range with a used-available design (as in the S2 selection in DeCesare et al. 2012). I can include distance from the initial nesting area as a variable in a logistic regression model, but I would like to be able to truly separate these processes to ensure they are being modeled independently. 

I have not been able to find any literature where such a model was developed, and things I have tried haven't worked out too well. Does anyone have any insights?   

Thanks in advance,
